verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document a first-party feature for exporting all tenant data in open formats to support leaving the service. Diagnostic-settings log routing covers only activity logs, kept for retention and insights. The Graph user-list API and SCIM provisioning are developer and provisioning building blocks, not a documented export-and-leave capability, so none of these earn credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
